description: Sensitive areas currently identified in the UK under the Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive since 1994 is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs. This lists current designations of sensitive areas identified under the urban waste water treatment directive across the UK. Environmental waters are designated as sensitive areas where they are in need of protection through the provision of tertiary treatment at sewage treatment plants whose discharges adversely impact the waters. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, XLS , XLSM. The portal shows 2013-12-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
